findings.claim: retry() assigns a new task_id via uuid4 instead of reusing the original id, violating the retry-must-preserve-id invariant.
findings.failure_scenario: A task with task_id "abc-123" fails and is retried; retry() overwrites task.task_id with a freshly generated uuid (e.g. "9f2e..."). Any downstream consumer that dedupes completions or correlates callbacks by the original task_id "abc-123" will no longer recognize the retried task, causing duplicate processing or lost correlation.
